summary.text: Joe Pittman is a Republican and Senate Majority Leader who represents Pennsylvania's 41st Senatorial District in Armstrong, Indiana, Jefferson and Westmoreland Counties.

paragraphs.text: Pittman is a lifelong resident of Indiana County and is serving his second full term in the Senate. Before his election he was chief of staff to former Sen. Don White.

He holds a bachelor's degree in political science from Penn State University, is a past board member of the United Way of Indiana, and lives in Indiana County with his wife Gina and their four children.
